title: Princ Engr-Software Devt
description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.
  
  

* AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps
* Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers: Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.
* Process Mapping & Platform Integration: Analyze enterprise workflows to define operational logic, boundary conditions, and guardrails for agents deployed on the AI platform, ensuring high reusability and fast speed-to-value.
* Foundation Model Management: Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* LLMOps & Governance: Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.
* Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture
* End-to-End Systems Engineering: Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* High-Performance Frontends: Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* API & Microservices Design: Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.
* Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics
* Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy: Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (AWS, GCP) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* Data Persistence Models: Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.
* Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
* Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

+ Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
+ Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
+ Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices

* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

+ Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
+ Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
+ Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
+ Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
+ Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
+ Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
+ Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
+ Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
+ Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
+ Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
+ Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)
* Knowledge and experience of Docker/Container technologies
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
* Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in computer science or computer engineering.
* Evaluate and choose appropriate technologies, design patterns, and algorithms for the development of robust and scalable software solutions
* Innovation mindset
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills ability to assimilate data from varied sources, apply deductive reasoning and scientific method, make inferences, draw testable conclusions, and resolve problems.
* Experience in virtualization and cloud platforms.
* Experience in building large scale systems-management, network monitoring systems, and monitoring applications.
* Ability to handle teams from multiple locations and working in an onshore/offshore model.
* Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt it to new hardware, or to upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
* Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.
  
  
Where you’ll be working
  
  
In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager.
  
  
Scheduled Weekly Hours
  
  
40
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity
  
  
Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, gender, disability or any other legally protected characteristics.

title: Adv. Eng. II
description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities:**




+ Design, develop, and customize Alfresco Content Services solutions, including workflows, custom content models, and integrations with external systems.
+ Deploy and manage Alfresco instances on AWS infrastructure (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM), leveraging cloud services for scalability, security, and high availability.
+ Integrate Alfresco with other applications using microservices architecture (Spring Boot), REST APIs, and Node.js services.
+ Build and maintain modern front-end components for Alfresco applications using Angular and JavaScript.
+ Integrate, configure, and optimize Apache Solr for advanced search capabilities within Alfresco solutions, ensuring fast and accurate content retrieval.
+ Apply SQL expertise for efficient data storage, retrieval, and performance tuning within Alfresco deployments.
+ Monitor and tune Alfresco performance, including database connection pools, Solr indexing, and AWS resource utilization.
+ Debug and resolve technical issues related to Alfresco, SQL, AWS, JavaScript frameworks, and Solr components.
+ Work closely with cross-functional teams, including architects, DevOps engineers, and business stakeholders, to deliver solutions aligned with organizational goals.
+ Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration guides, and user manuals, to support ongoing development and knowledge sharing.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**




+ 5+ years of hands-on experience with Alfresco Content Services (Enterprise Edition).
+ 2+ years of experience working with AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, IAM).
+ Strong knowledge of Java, Spring Framework, and RESTful APIs.
+ Experience in designing and implementing Alfresco content models, behaviours, web scripts, workflows, and REST APIs.
+ Experience developing integrations with external systems and building modern front-end components using Angular/ADF (Alfresco Development Framework).
+ Familiarity with ACS and APS SDKs.

* Preferred/Good to Have:

+ Experience with ACS 6.x or later versions and understanding of the latest architecture.
+ Exposure to CI/CD processes using tools like Jenkins, Bitbucket/GitHub.
+ Hands-on experience with Docker, Docker Compose, and Kubernetes.
+ Certification in Alfresco Content Services or AWS (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Developer).
+ Experience with Alfresco integrations using AWS S3 for content storage or AWS Aurora for database management.
+ Familiarity with microservices architecture and serverless computing on AWS.
+ Knowledge of other ECM platforms or programming languages (Python, Kotlin).

* Soft Skills:

+ Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
+ Excellent communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
+ Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Full Time / Part Time**
Full time
  
  
**Worker Type**
Employee
  
  
**Job Exempt (Yes / No)**
Yes
  
  
**Workplace Model**
At Invesco, our workplace model supports our culture and meets the needs of our clients while providing flexibility our employees value. As a full-time employee, compliance with the workplace policy means working with your direct manager to create a schedule where you will work in your designated office at least three days a week, with two days working outside an Invesco office.
  
  
**Why Invesco**
In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.
  
  
We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).
  
  
**What’s in it for you?**
As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.
  
  
Our benefit policy includes but not limited to:
  

* Competitive Compensation
* Flexible, Hybrid Work
* 30 days’ Annual Leave + Public Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Retirement Planning
* Group Personal Accident Insurance
* Medical Insurance for Employee and Family
* Annual Health Check-up
* 26 weeks Maternity Leave
* Paternal Leave
* Adoption Leave
* Near site Childcare Facility
* Employee Assistance Program
* Study Support
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* ESG Commitments and Goals
* Business Resource Groups
* Career Development Programs
* Mentoring Programs
* Invesco Cares
* Dress for your Day

In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.
  
  
**To Know More About Us**
About Invesco: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/home.html
  
  
About our Culture: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/about-us/our-culture.html
  
  
About our D&I policy: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/our-commitments/diversity-and-inclusion.html
  
  
About our CR program: https://www.invesco.com/corporate/en/our-commitments/corporate-responsibility.html

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Arcadis is the world's leading company delivering sustainable design, engineering, and consultancy solutions for natural and built assets.
  
  
We are more than 34,000 people, in over 30 countries, dedicated to improving quality of life. Everyone has an important role to play. With the power of many curious minds, together we can solve the world’s most complex challenges and deliver more impact together.
  
  
**Role description:**
Enable reliable, secure, and scalable software delivery by designing, building, and operating DevOps platforms, pipelines, and practices that support global enabling function products and services.
  
  
**Role accountabilities:**
**Individual accountabilities:**
**Leadership**

* Act as a senior technical leader and role model for DevOps practices across enabling function software teams.
* Mentor and support engineers and product teams in CI/CD, automation, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Collaborate closely with software engineering, platform, security, and architecture teams to align delivery practices.
* Proactively identify risks, bottlenecks, and improvement opportunities in the software delivery lifecycle.

**Technical Skills**

* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support reliable and repeatable software releases.
* Implement infrastructure-as-code and configuration management for cloud and platform environments.
* Embed security, compliance, and quality controls into delivery pipelines (DevSecOps).
* Support cloud-native architectures, container platforms, and automation tooling.
* Troubleshoot complex delivery, infrastructure, and production issues across environments.

**Accountability**

* Accountable for adherence to agreed standards, guardrails, and governance for enabling function software delivery.

**Key Shared Accountabilities:**

* Contribute to achieving enabling function software delivery performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency targets.
* Support continuous improvement of shared platforms, tooling, and engineering standards.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* A minimum of 5 years and up to 15 deep hands-on experience in Azure DevOps, and platform engineering
* Strong technical expertise in GitHub Actions, C#, JavaScript, ReactJS, and Terraform.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently resolve complex technical issues.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills in a global, cross-functional environment.
* Proven ability to balance delivery speed with security, reliability, and quality.

Why Arcadis?
  
  
We can only achieve our goals when everyone is empowered to be their best. We believe everyone's contribution matters. It’s why we are pioneering a skills-based approach, where you can harness your unique experience and expertise to carve your career path and maximize the impact we can make together.
  
  
You’ll do meaningful work, and no matter what role, you’ll be helping to deliver sustainable solutions for a more prosperous planet. Make your mark, on your career, your colleagues, your clients, your life and the world around you.
  
  
Together, we can create a lasting legacy.
  
  
Join Arcadis. Create a Legacy.
  
  
Our Commitment to Equality, Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging
  
  
We want you to be able to bring your best self to work every day, which is why we take equality and inclusion seriously and hold ourselves to account for our actions. Our ambition is to be an employer of choice and provide a great place to work for all our people. At Arcadis, you will have the opportunity to build the career that is right for you. Because each Arcadian has their own motivations, their own career goals. And, as a ‘people ﬁrst’ business, it is why we will take the time to listen, to understand what you want from your time here, and provide the support you need to achieve your ambitions.

description:

 Minimum 10\+years of experience in total.
   

  

* Ensure services solutions platforms products are fit for purpose and achieve the desired business value and impact

While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of good health.

 Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.

 \#Sandoz

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Zelis is modernizing the healthcare financial experience in the United States (U.S.) across payers, providers, and healthcare consumers. We serve more than 750 payers, including the top five national health plans, regional health plans, TPAs and millions of healthcare providers and consumers across our platform of solutions. Zelis sees across the system to identify, optimize, and solve problems holistically with technology built by healthcare experts – driving real, measurable results for clients.
   

  

 At Zelis, AI is woven into the fabric of how we work. Every associate is expected \- and empowered \- to partner with AI to challenge the status quo, accelerate innovation, and amplify their impact. This is a place for builders with a growth mindset who act with agility, embrace change, and use modern technology to shape smarter solutions, exceptional experiences, and the future of our industry for our clients, customers, and our culture.
   

  

**Why We Do What We Do**
 In the U.S., consumers, payers, and providers face significant challenges throughout the healthcare financial journey. Zelis helps streamline the process by offering solutions that improve transparency, efficiency, and communication among all parties involved. By addressing the obstacles that patients face in accessing care, navigating the intricacies of insurance claims, and the logistical challenges healthcare providers encounter with processing payments, Zelis aims to create a more seamless and effective healthcare financial system.
   

  

 Zelis India plays a crucial role in this mission by supporting various initiatives that enhance the healthcare financial experience. The local team contributes to the development and implementation of innovative solutions, ensuring that technology and processes are optimized for efficiency and effectiveness. Beyond operational expertise, Zelis India cultivates a collaborative work culture, leadership development, and global exposure, creating a dynamic environment for professional growth. With hybrid work flexibility, comprehensive healthcare benefits, financial wellness programs, and cultural celebrations, we foster a holistic workplace experience. Additionally, the team plays a vital role in maintaining high standards of service delivery and contributes to Zelis’ award\-winning culture.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with deep expertise in AWS cloud services, Amazon EKS, and containerized platforms to design, build, and operate scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Architect, build, and maintain scalable platform solutions using AWS services with a strong focus on EKS and containerization.
* Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS CDK, enabling fully automated and repeatable cloud provisioning.
* Develop and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, leveraging YAML and PowerShell scripting to drive automation.
* Deploy, manage, and optimize workloads across AWS and Azure, including Windows Services and .NET\-based applications.
* Implement and enforce cloud security best practices, including secure networking, IAM, secret management, and compliance controls.
* Integrate application and security scanning tools such as Veracode into CI/CD pipelines to ensure continuous security validation.
* Drive DevOps automation best practices, improving deployment reliability, observability, and operational efficiency.
* Collaborate closely with development, security, and architecture teams to streamline delivery workflows and enhance platform reliability.
* Lead and support AI adoption initiatives, including the responsible use of AWS Bedrock and Copilot\-based tools to improve productivity and automation.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Strong hands\-on experience with AWS core services, including EKS, IAM, VPC, EC2, and related managed services.
* Proven experience with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.
* Expertise in CDK Workflows, CI/CD pipeline engineering using GitHub Actions or similar tools.
* Solid scripting skills in PowerShell and experience authoring YAML\-based workflows.
* Experience deploying and supporting Windows\-based and .NET workloads in cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of DevSecOps principles, including automated security scanning and compliance.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.


 Nice to Have
   

  

* Experience with multi\-cloud architectures (AWS and Azure).
* Exposure to AI/ML platform services and developer productivity tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, performance optimization, and monitoring expertise.


**Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging**
 At Zelis, we champion diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our operations. We embrace the power of diversity and create an environment where people can bring their authentic and best selves to work. We know that a sense of belonging is key not only to your success at Zelis, but also to your ability to bring your best each day.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity**
 Zelis is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
   

  

**Accessibility Support**
 We are dedicated to ensuring our application process is accessible to all candidates. If you are a qualified individual with a disability and require reasonable accommodation with any part of the application and/or interview process, please email talentacquisition@zelis.com.

title: Manager II
description:
**Overview**
 As a Manager \- II , you will work closely with key product and engineering stakeholders to implement integrated environments for a wide range of complex products at RealPage across teams . Included management of team, business uses to technical impact analysis and driving to implementation of these use cases through Infrastructure, Configuration as code and O rchestration based automation across on\-prem and Cloud H ybrid environments.
   

  

 Manager  should manage, mentor, coach \& deliver technical guidance and indus tr y best practi c es to a group of Infra automation engineers responsible for products of the large and complex environment.
   

  

 This position will report to the IT Director in India and functionally will work with a Sr. Director in US.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Overall 8 \- 10 years’ experience in IT with strong technical exposure on automation (IAC, CAC \& DevOps) .
* A passion for Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, DevOps, Automation and running highly resilient/automated system for Hybrid environments .
* Be able to work in USA late morning, early afternoon hours .
* Mandatory knowledge in tool stacks: Azure DevOPs , Ansible, Terraform tools, Packer, Kubernetes
* Have previous programming/development background (Python, Orchestration tools) .
* Compile KPIs and evangelize the adoption of best practices in relation to Integrated environment use cases across the organization .
* Embed into Integrated Environment projects use cases and on\-call rotations to keep your skills sharp and stay close to the operational workflows and issues .
* Promote a healthy and functional work environment .
* Maintain project and operational workload statistics .
* Provide a solid foundation for building and maintaining successful Hybrid Infrastructure automation teams.
* Utilize technical knowledge and experience with complex systems and performance to maintain and enhance the company’s platform .


**Detailed Description**
* This individual should enjoy working in a fast\-paced environment where adaptability and flexibility is key to their success.
* Implementation of industry recommended best practices and provide technical guidance and support with accountability.
* Work with a diverse  team, developing both the technical capabilities and leadership qualities of engineers and technicians.
* Manage system automation, upgrades, integration, automated provisioning process, rebuilds and other projects as required .
* Implement process improvements and inform best practices in  automation and operations.
* Working with senior management to propose, agree, and deliver IT service with defined Service Level Agreements.
* Establish systems monitoring capabilities to proactively address issues .
* Establish application/ systems patch management procedures .
* Develop strategic goals and objectives for quality improvements.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal .
* Systematic, disciplined, and analytical approach to problem solving and detail oriented .
* Strong analytical and reasoning skills; must be effective at summarizing and communicating complex information .
* Demonstrated professional maturity to handle confidential information .
* Self\-starter and able to work effectively in a deadline\-driven environment .
* Ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously with only general direction and minimal supervision .
* Solid organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and manage time effectively to meet deadlines .


**Qualifications**
* 8\-10 Years with a minimum of architect experience .
* At least 5\+ years of work experience in Orchestration based automation for a team for Infrastructure and Configuration as Code .
* Proven track record of designing, building, optimizing , and maintaining infrastructure on a large scale .
* Preferred candidates with professional experience starting from a product developer role and transitioning to a Hybrid Infrastructure automation engineer .
* A passion for Automation/ DevOps and running highly resilient/automated systems.
* 2\+ Experience in On\-prem to cloud Migration of products .
* Strong understanding of SDLC , Linux and Windows environments .
* Detailed u nderstanding of DevOps Process \& Tools (Azure DevOps, GITHUB, Packer, Azure Cloud , Artifactory etc ) .
* Mandatory a utomation background ( Terraform, Python, P owershell , A nsible, Linux/W indows desired state configuration) .
* Basic project management skills.
* Ability to work overtime when necessary.
